title: Publish Resume feedback body deltas without sequence holes or same-revision duplicates
outcome: Resume terminal feedback updates use contiguous body sequences and one appropriate publication per revision, avoiding forced full-snapshot refetches.
acceptance: Build Resume message-update delta parts before the commit advances the body clock, and avoid publishing a full state and stale delta at the same revision when marking reporting Unknown.
A regression verifies terminal and Unknown Resume updates preserve the expected body sequence and client recovery does not require a snapshot solely because of these publications.
